title: Pure War Rock
summary: Pure War Rock battle-focused beatdown strategy, fielding robust EARTH Warrior barbarians that gain cumulative attack boosts and trigger searches, destructions, and summons during combat. The deck leverages the Battle Phase to shut down opposing monster effects and swarm the board.

summary.title: Starters
points: War Rock Mountain searches any War Rock monster from your Deck upon activation, and Special Summons an EARTH Warrior from your hand at the start of either player's Battle Phase.

War Rock Fortia searches any War Rock card from your Deck at the end of the Damage Step if an EARTH Warrior battles, and Special Summons a Level 5 or higher War Rock from Deck if sent to the GY by the opponent.
War Rock Gactos Special Summons itself from hand whenever you Normal Summon an EARTH Warrior monster.

War Rock Medium Sets a War Rock Spell or Trap directly from your Deck on activation, and prevents the opponent from activating monster effects on the field during Main Phase 1 while you control a Level 7 or higher War Rock.
War Rock Orpis can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if you control an EARTH Warrior, and sends an EARTH Warrior from Deck to GY after battling.
War Rock Mammud can be Normal Summoned without Tributing and destroys an opponent's Spell or Trap Card after battling.

summary.title: Opening: Mountain + Fortia
steps: Activate War Rock Mountain, searching War Rock Fortia from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon War Rock Fortia; if you hold War Rock Gactos, Special Summon Gactos immediately.
Activate War Rock Medium from hand, setting War Rock Dignity directly from your Deck.
Enter the Battle Phase; Mountain triggers to Special Summon War Rock Meteoragon (or Bashileos) from hand.
Attack with Fortia; at the end of the Damage Step, trigger Fortia to search War Rock Bashileos, boosting all your War Rocks by 200 ATK.
Set Dignity to negate monster effects during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Battle Phasing
points: War Rock Meteoragon cannot be destroyed by opponent card effects, can attack monsters twice per Battle Phase, and negates the effects of any monster it battles and all cards with that same original name until the end of the turn.
War Rock Bashileos can attack directly, and Special Summons itself from hand or GY when an EARTH Warrior you control is destroyed by battle.
War Rock Skyler gains 200 ATK when battling and can Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from your GY during battle.
Generic Rank 5 Xyz Monsters like Imperial Princess Quinquery, Number 61: Volcasaurus, Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon, and Tiras, Keeper of Genesis can be overlaid using Level 5 Orpis and Mammud.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: War Rock Dignity is a Quick-Play Spell that negates an opponent monster's activated effect while you control a War Rock, or negates any card activation during the Battle Phase.
War Rock Spirit revives an EARTH Warrior from your GY in Attack Position during the Battle Phase.
War Rock Generations Special Summons a War Rock monster directly from your Deck during the Battle Phase if the opponent controls more monsters than you.
War Rock Big Blow destroys up to two cards on the field if an opponent card leaves the field while a War Rock monster is destroyed.
War Rock Ordeal places counters when War Rock monsters destroy monsters by battle, drawing up to 3 cards during the End Phase.
